Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear timeline. Short answer: yes, we can support a staggered PO and a term amendment to 18 months. Below is a concise mutual action plan and the exact artifacts your procurement portal will need. I've attached a one-page vendor_onboard_checklist for your intake team.

Mutual action plan (owner / due date):
- Redwood provides amended SOW and signature-ready DocuSign (Aditya) — due 2026-10-15
- Globex uploads evidence to procurement portal: SOC2 report (most recent), DPA, W-9, SOW-signed (Sarah) — due 2026-10-22
- Finance issues first PO (60% capacity uplift + prorated term) (Tom) — target 2026-10-25
- Redwood validates portal evidence and enables capacity uplift (Marissa/Infra) — target 2026-10-27
- Finance issues second PO (remaining 40%) — target 2026-12-01

Notes on staggered PO: we recommend splitting as 60/40 (first PO covers immediate uplift and pro-rated 18-month term start; second PO completes the committed capacity for the remainder of the term). This reduces your need for multiple onboarding cycles while letting you accelerate capacity.

Required artifacts to upload (procurement portal):
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (most recent)
- Data Processing Addendum (signed)
- Completed vendor onboarding form / W-9
- Signed SOW amendment (DocuSign link will be provided)

Attachments: vendor_onboard_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

I'll loop in Laura on invoicing options and Hannah on evidence validation. Will send the DocuSign link for the SOW amendment today.

Best,

Hi Sarah / Aditya — quick finance/legal note on how we usually handle staggered POs:

- We can support invoice consolidation under a single contract amendment so your AP team sees one vendor relationship (reduces PO churn). The two POs will reference the same deal id (GLX-2026-R1) and the same signed SOW amendment.
- Standard payment terms: Net 45 (we can discuss Net 30 for enterprise customers, but would need approval).
- I'll attach the SOW amendment draft; please review the term change language (12 -> 18 months) and the capacity uplift schedule in Exhibit A.
